entries.title: Matthew 10:1
segments: Gave them authority, etc.  The disciples were not only to teach, but to exercise in their appointed measure the miraculous power of the Master.

entries.title: Matthew 10:2
segments: Apostles. Messengers, envoys, those sent forth.

entries.title: Matthew 10:5
segments: These twelve. In all four evangelists as well as in Acts there is a list of the twelve apostles, but in no two is the order in which they are mentioned exactly the same.

entries.title: Matthew 10:6
segments: Go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel. The Gentiles and the cities of the Samaritans were temporarily excluded from the mission work of the twelve; preaching and healing among them were postponed.

entries.title: Matthew 10:7
segments: The kingdom of heaven is at hand. The saying implied an appeal and warning to prepare for it.

entries.title: Matthew 10:8
segments: Freely ye received, freely give. They were to be gladly willing and self-sacrificing in their service.

entries.title: Matthew 10:11
segments: Who in it is worthy. Whosoever received the disciples kindly and entertained them.

entries.title: Matthew 10:12
segments: Salute it. The usual form was 'peace be to this house.'

entries.title: Matthew 10:14
segments: Shake off the dust of your feet. It was a common saying among the Jews that the dust of heathen lands defiled the feet.  In this case rejection of the doctrine of Jesus by the Jews was to receive the same sign of condemnation as if they were heathens.

entries.title: Matthew 10:15
segments: Shall be more tolerable. Sins of weakness and ignorance are more worthy of pardon than deliberate, willful sins against a clear conscience.

entries.title: Matthew 10:16
segments: Wise as serpents, etc.  Tactful, quiet, without offence to those among whom they preached and worked.

entries.title: Matthew 10:17
segments: Beware of men. They were warned to watch the moods and schemes of those who would hinder and destroy their usefulness.

entries.title: Matthew 10:18
segments: Governors and kings. As Paul was brought before Festus and Agrippa (

entries.title: Matthew 10:22
segments: Hated of all men for my name's sake. The natural hatred of the world and the flesh for the rule of the Spirit, which was demanded in the name of Jesus.

entries.title: Matthew 10:25
segments: As his teacher. The disciple should be expected to endure all the persecution that befalls his teacher.

entries.title: Matthew 10:27
segments: In the darkness. Jesus began in an obscure corner of the earth, despised Galilee; the work was carried by his disciples to the great cities of the world.

entries.title: Matthew 10:34
segments: I came not to send peace, but a sword. He who accepts as his guide and inspiration the words and life of Christ must expect to endure the consequences.

entries.title: Matthew 10:37
segments: More than me. The most sacred family ties are to be sundered if they conflict with the supreme claim of Christ's love. Compare

entries.title: Matthew 10:38
segments: Take his cross. A still costlier sacrifice is demanded.  The true believer must even take and bear his cross, as Christ did, to the scene of his death.  Jesus may have referred to his coming crucifixion.

entries.title: Matthew 10:39
segments:
Shall lose it. Shall lose the higher, larger life by being contented with the lower and smaller.
 

 
Shall find it. Shall find the spiritual, eternal life through loss of the life of earthly ambitions and pleasures.  Christ's aim is to impress by means of striking contrasts the true meaning of life and of love and the self-denial each calls for.

entries.title: Matthew 10:40
segments: Receiveth me. The welcome given to the messenger or representative of Christ is accounted as given to Christ himself.

entries.title: Matthew 10:41
segments: In the name of a prophet. Out of respect to the office and work of a prophet.

entries.title: Matthew 10:42
segments: These little ones. The apostles.
